_instructions: Copy this file to config.json and fill in real data. Omit blocks that don't apply to your accountType (see comments below). Every value is a string unless noted. Dropdown values must match the exact option label shown in the UI (see specs/SILVER_TS001-test-plan.md / NORMAL_TS001-test-plan.md for confirmed option lists).
applicationMobile: <real 10-digit mobile number for the very first Mobile Number Verification step - the account holder's own number for individual/joint, or just the initiating number for minor>

branch.branchName: <only used if change=true, e.g. 'GOREGAON BRANCH' - must exactly match a card in the Change Branch list>

applicant._comment: Present for accountType=individual|joint. Omit entirely for accountType=minor.
applicant.email: <real email, avoid a dot in the local part before @ - BUG-NORMAL-004 rejects e.g. first.last@x.com>
applicant.spouseOrFatherName: <only if Married, else leave empty string>
applicant.employmentType: Salaried, comment: e.g. Salaried | Self employed | Unemployed | Professional | Agriculture/Farmer | Retired | Housewife | Other | Business
applicant.fundingMode: Cash, comment: 'Cash' or 'Cheque' - application-level, only set on applicant (or minor block for minor accounts), never on jointApplicant/guardian

employmentInfo._comment: Fields used depend on employmentType: Salaried -> Salaried Information (category/organizationName/annualIncome/sourceOfIncome); Self employed -> Self Employed Information (category/organizationName/annualTurnover/sourceOfIncome); other types may skip this step entirely.

jointApplicant._comment: Present only when accountType=joint. Same shape as 'applicant' minus fundingMode/chequeDetails (those are application-level, set on 'applicant' only), plus relationshipWithMain and their own real mobile.
jointApplicant.relationshipWithMain: Others, comment: exact dropdown option - Friend is NOT available, use Others/Business Associate/etc.

minor._comment: Present only when accountType=minor. Describes the child themselves (Minor KYC Details + their own Address/Basic Details). Mode of Operation is always 'Guardian' - handled automatically.
minor.prefix: Master, comment: Master for male minor, Baby/Kumari for female
minor.employmentType: Unemployed, comment: Unemployed routes straight to Guardian Details with no employment-info step

guardian._comment: Present only when accountType=minor. The guardian's OWN full sub-journey - their own real mobile, eKYC, liveliness, address, basic details, employment, photo.
guardian.relationshipWithMain: Father, comment: exact dropdown option - e.g. Father/Mother/Natural Guardian (Natural Guardian has intermittently failed to resolve as selectable - Father/Mother are more reliable)

documents._comment: List the mandatory-marked document type FIRST (currently 'Ration Card *' on both schemes) to avoid the confirmed silent document-loss defect. Additional optional types can follow.

introducer._comment: Skipped automatically if the Introducer Details tab never appears for this scheme/accountType combination (e.g. Silver Individual/Minor skip it).
